policy:public.schedules.shared_schedule_.check:
(((sharing_approval_id IS NULL) AND (person_schedule_id IS NULL)) OR med_tracker.sharing_origin_execution(id, (person_schedule_id)::text, person_id, household_id, canonical_origin) OR (execution_ended_at IS NOT NULL) OR (med_tracker.sharing_current_member(person_id) AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM person_household_approvals approval
  WHERE ((approval.ended_at IS NULL) AND (approval.id = schedules.sharing_approval_id)))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (shared_schedule_executions link
     JOIN person_household_approvals approval ON ((approval.id = link.approval_id)))
  WHERE ((link.schedule_id = schedules.id) AND (approval.ended_at IS NULL)))))))
